YOUR DATA · EXPLICIT REFERENCE · ISOLATED REPAIRS

Investigate your own snapshots.

Compare complete CSV exports of the same population and reporting date. Declare why you trust the reference, choose identity columns, and inspect exact differences before testing replacements or removals.

Exact text comparison across every column. Both files must have the same column names; order may differ. Composite identities are supported. Dates and authority are your declarations, not automatically verified source metadata.

DATA ENGINEERING · REUSABLE CSV PIPELINES

Make quality a release gate.

Define a versioned data contract, validate each batch, and publish only a passing snapshot. Keep rejected rows and the previous trusted output available.

Each batch is a complete snapshot. Keys are unique within a batch; there is no incremental merge or streaming.

Create or revise a data contract

Load the selected CSV’s columns, choose types and required fields, and mark a unique key (one or more columns). Reuse a pipeline name to save a new immutable version. No types are inferred.

ORDER COMMITMENTS → DELIVERY PERFORMANCE

Which orders need attention?

Check overdue commitments and delivery timing across teams. Quarantine unreliable records, inspect the source, and keep a review history.

Choose the date this file represents. Days are calendar days. Orders due on this date are due today, not overdue. An empty delivery date means undelivered.
